_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores or through our e-commerce and mobile capabilities'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or the integration of both), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions and other economic factors, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2017 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart

theme_watch.reason: Live: Walmart's own FY2017 10-K says 'We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or the integration of both), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'E-commerce sales positively impacted comparable sales approximately 0.4% and 0.7% for Walmart U.S. and Sam's Club, respectively, for fiscal 2017', and 'In September 2016, we completed the acquisition of Jet.com, Inc.'. The stock trades at 18.0x FY18E — a premium. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of e-commerce to 2017-06-16 (Amazon agrees to buy Whole Foods; grocers and food retailers sell off the same day), evidence that names no company. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Walmart's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores or through our e-commerce and mobile capabilities'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or the integration of both), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions and other economic factors, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2017 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +39% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.08; conservative 2yr -10%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -9.5%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.0%/yr (Q2 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.0%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +11.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2017-09-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (43.9% downside to Bear $44 / +-0.5% upside to Bull $78) | Adj composite 1.67 vs market 3.75: gap -2.08 [OVERVALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $57 (13x FY18E $4.35) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.5% total (-5.3%/yr) | At 18.0x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $104 sits above the BULL case; U.S. comps +1.8% in Q2 FY18, forward sales +3% (no FY18 net sales guide in numbers, Q2 FY18 net sales at constant currency); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
